essence: Sevenfold six-and-half scripture: taught by Supreme Lord alone.
The seven power-bearing: Śiva to sakala ladder named.
Seven powers × fourteen differences → fifteenfold up to earth-principal-tattva.
Śākta rūpa: Aparā-grace knowability-form in power-raised knower-objects — sevenfold.
Śiva rūpa: parābhaṭṭārikā-grace resting power-bearing form in knower-class — sevenfold too.
Seven per rūpa because those-many named from Śiva to sakala-limit.
Knower-difference = śakti-difference alone; ladder-order types each level by specificity or objectlessness.
Vijñānākala: impression-helper awakening śuddhavidyā of mantra.
Mantreśa: that śuddhavidyā impression-free, awakened alone.
She seeks will-power autonomy-form at mantra-maheśa.
Seven primary power-differences close: icchātmikā … distinct-autonomy-Śiva.
Only power can be karaṇī-kartṛ: instrument→agent difference ends in uparāga-śakti, no regress.
Reality: one consciousness-autonomy-bliss-resting pramātā; other-forms power-made; jānāmi-pratyaya differs there.
Objection: naive vedyatā → regress, world-blind-light, opposite-qualities union.
Answer: vedyatā = viśrānti-bhājana in pramātṛ-śakti, self-luminous toward none — sarvajñatā, faults removed.
One rūpa serves infinite via ekābhāsa (blue/dancer analogies), real by artha-kriyā; fifteenfold = its shining-structure.
Sakala pañcadaśa from raised-passion-curtain's that-much vedyatā.
Settled spread in Tantrāloka — cross-reference.
Male-to-segment-tattva span: thirteenfold second count.
Pralayākala: eleven differences (five-pramātṛtve).
Vijñānākala: nine (four-pramātṛtve).
Mantra: seven (three).
Mantreśa: five (two).
Maheśa: three (one, by power-split).
Śiva: zero bheda — paripūrṇatā closes the count.
One-name policy + bheda = variegated worlds despite equal earthness.
Inner-bheda curiosity → determine Tantrāloka.
Per-pot tracking establishes tattva-bheda by example.
Earth-tattva as knower-known-form: its abheda-prakāśa is Śiva.
Śruti warrant: in earth this very brahman.
Earth-mantra chain: maheśvara→mantreśa→abhimānika-vācaka→abhyasta-yoga→vijñānākala (unstable).
Bonded-track earth-yoga ends in dharā-pralaya-kevala.
Deep sleep: tattva-veśa-driven dream; identity stays sakala-dharā.
Earth fourteenfold here (power-absence −1); svarūpa pure prameya.
Sixteen-segment blue-analysis: 4 named + 12 middle (6 nirvikalpa + 6 pairs) = six-tuṭi cycle.
Grāhakarūpatā not counted; guru's pupils divide fifteenfold everywhere.
Segments scale with concepts: floor at avikalpatā.
Worlds misread the avikalpā vimarśa-bhūmi as dark; vikalpa-decrease reveals — sāvadhānatā is method (guru-view).
Halving to two-segment Śiva-immersion; the second tuṭi is sarvajña-apt, not first.
Tuṭi-pāta = Kālī = mātṛ-sat-bhāva = bhairava-pratibhā; disclosure halts (alam).
Segment-practice maps to corresponding siddhi.
Avasthā = relational vaicitrya: neither term alone nor two separate.
Waking = bahīrūpa-bhāna by object-rulership (meya/mātṛ/māna).
Dream = same locus, adhiṣṭhāna-rūpa-bhāna, saṃkalpa.
Deep sleep = adhiṣṭhātṛ-rūpa, bījātman-bhāna only.
Three states × four differences = twelve.
Turyā: pūrṇatā-door 'I-see', aṃśatraya-crossing, unmediated pramātṛtā anoints triad; tribhedā by service.
Two vocabularies for four states: yogin vs contemplation-wealthy.
Anvartha shown in Tantrāloka + Ślokavārttika.
Turyātīta = sarvāntarbhūta-pūrṇa-rūpa = mahā-pracaya.
State-level map: distinct→opposite→ākala-bhogas→śivābhedas→beyond-fourth/beyond-all.
Five avasthās keyed to level-classes within pañcadaśa.
Descent-table 13→11→9→7→5→3; tribheda tri-power structuring underwrites pañca-pada — counts converge.

rasa.dominant: jñāna with śānta weight (knowledge as calm enumeration)
rasa.justification: The relish is the count settling:15, 13, 11, 9, 7, 5, 3, 0 — each number a landing; the ekābhāsa passage (u16) and turyā (u47) open brief vistas, but the ahnika's heart is prasaṃkhyāna-dhana arithmetic; the Kālī-pāta halt (u40) is its one struck bell.

sections.FUNCTION: Establishes the seven-fold power-ladder and its arithmetic (pañcadaśa/trayodaśa/11-9-7-5-3-0 counts), the ekābhāsa doctrine of one-form-many-knowers, the objection-answer on vedyatā, the earth-mantra chain, the sixteen-segment tuṭi-analysis, and the four-avasthā system with turyā — closing with the descent-table.
sections.KEY TERMS: sapta-śaktimantaḥ (the seven power-bearing); pañcadaśa/trayodaśa-bheda (fifteen/thirteenfold counts); viśrānti-bhājana (rest-receptacle = vedyatā's locus); ekābhāsa (one-shining-form); tuṭi-ṣoḍaśaka (sixteen segments); sāvadhānatā (knowable-knower attentiveness, guru-view); turyā (fourth, 'I-see' aṃśatraya); avasthā-traya ×4 (twelve) + pañca-avasthā in pañcadaśa; śiva-abheda (zero-bheda at paripūrṇatā).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 9 carries the saptadhā-śāstra schema from a08; cross-links Tantrāloka (u18, u27, u49) + Ślokavārttika (u49) + Śrīkallaṭa (u40) + Abhinavagupta-guravaḥ (u38); the earth-series (u29-34) opens the pṛthivī-ādi treatment continued in later āhnikas.
sections.BOUNDARY: Thirteenfold vs fifteenfold counts juxtaposed without full reconciliation (u19 vs u3); tuṭi-math asserted (u35) with steps compacted; Kālī-pāta secret explicitly halted (alam, u40); two vocabularies for four states (u48) offered without equivalence proof; u53's table dense — each cell unexpanded.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) the seven-power ladder with three-grace rūpa-pairings (Aparā/parāparā/parābhaṭṭārikā) and count-arithmetic down to zero-bheda Śiva; (2) ekābhāsa epistemology answering the vedyatā-regress objection; (3) pṛthivī-tattva as Śiva-prakāśa with mantra-chain and bonded-track falls; (4) tuṭi-segment analysis of blue-perception with sāvadhānatā hermeneutic; (5) avasthā as relational vaicitrya → turyā anointing → dual vocabularies → level-mapping → the descent-table closing at tribheda-pañca-pada.
sections.RELATED: GRETIL Tantrasāra ahnika 9 (KSTS 17); Tantrāloka + Ślokavārttika cited; a08/a10 count-dialogue kin; earth-series continues in later āhnikas; qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
